WITH base AS (
    SELECT c.constituent_id,
           (NULLIF(TRIM(c.email), '') IS NOT NULL) AS has_email,
           (NULLIF(TRIM(c.address_line1), '') IS NOT NULL
            AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.address_city), '') IS NOT NULL
            AND c.address_state IS NOT NULL
            AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.address_postal_code), '') IS NOT NULL) AS has_address
    FROM constituent c
    WHERE c.entity_type = 'P'
      AND c.constituent_status = 'Active'
      AND c.is_deceased = FALSE
),
flags AS (
    SELECT b.constituent_id,
           (b.has_email AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM contact_preference cp
                WHERE cp.constituent_id = b.constituent_id
                  AND cp.preference_type IN ('Communication', 'Solicitations')
                  AND cp.restriction_type = 'Exclude'
                  AND cp.contact_method IN ('All', 'Email')
                  AND cp.department IS NULL
                  AND (cp.end_date IS NULL OR cp.end_date >= DATE '2026-09-23')
           )) AS email_reachable,
           (b.has_address AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM contact_preference cp
                WHERE cp.constituent_id = b.constituent_id
                  AND cp.preference_type IN ('Communication', 'Solicitations')
                  AND cp.restriction_type = 'Exclude'
                  AND cp.contact_method IN ('All', 'Letter')
                  AND cp.department IS NULL
                  AND (cp.end_date IS NULL OR cp.end_date >= DATE '2026-09-23')
           )) AS letter_reachable
    FROM base b
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS contactable_base_size
FROM flags
WHERE email_reachable OR letter_reachable;

request: Who gave last fiscal year but not this fiscal year?
response_text:
```sql
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE '2026-09-23')::int
         + CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE '2026-09-23') >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_fy
),
cash_hard AS (
    SELECT c.constituent_id, c.fiscal_year, c.amount, c.contribution_number
    FROM contribution c
    WHERE c.credit = 'Hard'
      AND c.contribution_type IN ('Gift', 'Pledge Payment', 'Matching Gift Payment', 'Bequest Expectancy Payment')
)
SELECT
    con.constituent_id,
    COALESCE(con.org_name, TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(con.preferred_name, con.first_name), con.last_name))) AS constituent_name,
    con.entity_type,
    con.primary_affiliation,
    con.is_deceased,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ch.contribution_number) AS last_fy_contribution_count,
    SUM(ch.amount) AS last_fy_total_given
FROM cash_hard ch
CROSS JOIN params p
JOIN constituent con
  ON con.constituent_id = ch.constituent_id
WHERE ch.fiscal_year = p.current_fy - 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM cash_hard ch2
      WHERE ch2.constituent_id = ch.constituent_id
        AND ch2.fiscal_year = p.current_fy
  )
GROUP BY
    con.constituent_id, con.org_name, con.preferred_name, con.first_name, con.last_name,
    con.entity_type, con.primary_affiliation, con.is_deceased
ORDER BY last_fy_total_given DESC;

request: Can you get me a household lists of donors to the School of Business who have given a lifetime amount of over $500
response_text:
```sql
WITH household_map AS (
    -- Householding: primary spouse = person1 in a 'Spouse' relationship; singles are their own primary
    SELECT c.constituent_id,
           COALESCE(r.person1_id, c.constituent_id) AS household_id
    FROM constituent c
    LEFT JOIN constituent_relationship r
           ON r.person2_id = c.constituent_id
          AND r.person1_role = 'Spouse'
          AND r.person2_role = 'Spouse'
),
household_gifts AS (
    -- Commitment basis (default): Pledge, Gift, Matching Gift, Bequest Expectancy
    -- Canceled pledges use pledge_amount_paid instead of amount
    -- Collapse hard/soft rows of the same contribution within a household so spouses are not double counted
    SELECT hm.household_id,
           ct.contribution_number,
           ct.designation_code,
           ct.contribution_type,
           MAX(CASE WHEN ct.contribution_type = 'Pledge' AND ct.pledge_status = 'Canceled'
                    THEN COALESCE(ct.pledge_amount_paid, 0)
                    ELSE ct.amount END) AS amount_any_credit,
           MAX(CASE WHEN ct.credit = 'Hard'
                    THEN CASE WHEN ct.contribution_type = 'Pledge' AND ct.pledge_status = 'Canceled'
                              THEN COALESCE(ct.pledge_amount_paid, 0)
                              ELSE ct.amount END
               END) AS amount_hard_only
    FROM contribution ct
    JOIN designation d
      ON d.designation_code = ct.designation_code
    JOIN household_map hm
      ON hm.constituent_id = ct.constituent_id
    WHERE d.division = 'School of Business'
      AND ct.contribution_type IN ('Pledge', 'Gift', 'Matching Gift', 'Bequest Expectancy')
    GROUP BY hm.household_id, ct.contribution_number, ct.designation_code, ct.contribution_type
),
household_totals AS (
    SELECT household_id,
           SUM(amount_any_credit)            AS lifetime_hard_plus_soft,
           COALESCE(SUM(amount_hard_only), 0) AS lifetime_hard_only
    FROM household_gifts
    GROUP BY household_id
)
SELECT ht.household_id,
       CASE WHEN p.entity_type = 'C' THEN p.org_name
            ELSE TRIM(COALESCE(p.preferred_name, p.first_name, '') || ' ' || p.last_name)
       END AS primary_name,
       CASE WHEN s.entity_type = 'C' THEN s.org_name
            ELSE TRIM(COALESCE(s.preferred_name, s.first_name, '') || ' ' || s.last_name)
       END AS spouse_name,
       ht.lifetime_hard_plus_soft,
       ht.lifetime_hard_only
FROM household_totals ht
JOIN constituent p
  ON p.constituent_id = ht.household_id
LEFT JOIN constituent_relationship r
  ON r.person1_id = ht.household_id
 AND r.person1_role = 'Spouse'
LEFT JOIN constituent s
  ON s.constituent_id = r.person2_id
WHERE ht.lifetime_hard_plus_soft > 500
ORDER BY ht.lifetime_hard_plus_soft DESC;
